systems.country_label: système de gestion et de production de la Carte nationale d'Identité biométrique sécurisée; base de données carte d'identité
systems.tiers: By the decree of 3 November 2022 the card is established or renewed by police commissioners, gendarmerie brigade commanders and sub-prefects, and abroad by heads of diplomatic and consular missions; fingerprints are kept in the card database and may be used to identify a person in judicial proceedings

note: No fact: a decree instituting the biometric identity card, which stations issue; it sets rules and says nothing of what is deployed or of the record a station makes of a report or case.
